entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
entries.target: 这个八腿机械构造体看上去像极了蜘蛛——一只哐当作响的巨大蜘蛛，正飞速向你冲来，准备用取代双颚的两把旋转锯刃将你切成碎片。

entries.source: #LIGHT_DARK#As %s falls you see its spirit rising for revenge.
entries.target: #LIGHT_DARK#%s倒下时，你看到其灵魂升起，前来复仇。

entries.source: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand. She is here to eliminate any and all aggression towards the Atmos tribe.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把蒸汽枪。她来此是为了铲除一切针对气之部族的侵犯。

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
entries.target: 这个八腿机械构造体看上去像极了蜘蛛——一只哐当作响的巨大蜘蛛，正飞速向你冲来，准备用取代双颚的两把旋转锯刃将你切成碎片。

entries.source: A mage dressed in glowing robes.
entries.target: 一个穿着荧光法袍的法师。

entries.source: A mage dressed in shining robes.
entries.target: 一个穿着闪亮法袍的法师。

entries.source: A mage dressed in ornate robes depicting both light and darkness.
entries.target: 一个穿着同时描绘了光与暗的华丽法袍的法师。

entries.source: A mage who has studied all there is to know about the stars and their working.
entries.target: 一个将毕生精力投入到了对星辰及其原理的学习中的法师。

entries.source: This guard stands tall and proud, wearing the symbol of the Sunwall.
entries.target: 这个身着太阳堡垒徽记的守卫挺拔而骄傲地站立着。

entries.source: You see an archer with his bow drawn back, and a golden sun embossed on his armor.
entries.target: 你看到了一个拉着弓的射手，他的护甲上有金色太阳的压纹。

entries.source: The shield of this soldier glows with a bright light. You see a golden sun engraved in its center, and he carries a sword in his other hand.
entries.target: 这个士兵的盾牌闪耀着强光。你看到盾牌的中央雕刻着一个金色的太阳，同时他的另一只手拿着一柄剑。

entries.source: The shield and sword of this soldier glow with a bright light. You see a golden sun engraved in the shield's center.
entries.target: 这个士兵的盾牌与剑都闪耀着强光。你看到盾牌的中央雕刻着一个金色的太阳。

entries.source: This mean looking soldier of the Sunwall holds steady his big two handed weapon, looking dangerously at you.
entries.target: 这个看上去十分凶恶的太阳堡垒士兵稳稳地握着一柄双手剑，他正在用危险的目光看着你。

entries.source: This creature looks like one of the steam giants, but nastier, bigger and somehow corrupted by unknown forces. Oh and it is wielding a huge maul too!
entries.target: 这个生物看上去像是一个蒸汽巨人，但是更巨大，更恶心，并且被某种未知力量腐化了。天啊，他还拿着一个巨锤！

entries.source: While a titan usually look like a corrupted steam giant, this one looks more like a giant-sized horrific mass of living flesh.
entries.target: 尽管一般的泰坦看上去像是一个堕落的蒸汽巨人，这一个看上去更像是一个巨人大小的恐怖血肉团块。

entries.source: Wreathed in arcane flames you can feel the intense psionic forces ripping at your mind emanating from this titan.
entries.target: 被奥术烈焰缠绕的泰坦散发出强烈的灵能力量，正撕扯着你的心灵。

entries.source: The wretched titan's skin is of a sickly green, full of ever-oozing wounds, cracks and pustules. Worms and all kind of vile things crawl over it.
entries.target: 这个恶心的泰坦皮肤呈病态的绿色，满是不停渗液的伤口、裂缝和脓疱。蠕虫和其他各种卑劣的东西在他身上爬来爬去。

entries.source: One of the biggest titans you have seen yet, it is fully clad in deep black stralite full plate, charging menacingly towards you at a terrible pace.
entries.target: 这是你迄今见过的最大泰坦之一，它身披一整套深黑色斯莱特板甲，正以骇人的速度向你猛冲而来。

entries.source: This abomination has the height of any other titan but its features definitively remind you of the few Sher'Tul images you have seen. Your very being rebels to the thought and sheer terror takes hold of your mind.
entries.target: 这个孽物和其他泰坦差不多高，但是他的特征让你回想起了你见过的那些夏·图尔人图片。你竭尽全力地抗拒这些想法，你的心灵已被纯粹的恐惧所控制。

entries.source: This abomination has the height of any other titan but its feature definitively remind you of the few Sher'Tul images you have seen. Your very being rebels to the thought and sheer terror takes hold of your mind.
entries.target: 这个孽物和其他泰坦差不多高，但是他的特征让你回想起了你见过的那些夏·图尔人图片。你竭尽全力地抗拒这些想法，你的心灵已被纯粹的恐惧所控制。

entries.source: This lean but muscular troll deftly wields two daggers. He glares at you with eyes filled with cunning.
entries.target: 这个精壮的巨魔熟练使用着一对匕首。他看向你的目光中满是狡诈。

entries.source: This troll is barking orders to the other trolls around him. He effortlessly holds a longsword in each hand.
entries.target: 这个巨魔正朝身旁的其他巨魔高声下令，双手各自轻松地握着一柄长剑。

entries.source: This troll carries a large sword and shield, and appears to be wearing segments of armor.
entries.target: 这只巨魔拿着巨大的剑盾，身上穿了一些零碎的护甲。

entries.source: This troll is holding a tall staff in one hand. Tendrils of water circle around it.
entries.target: 这只巨魔单手握着一根长杖，水之触手盘绕其上。

entries.source: A skeletal drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but if it's anything like living ones, it's probably not alone.
entries.target: 一只骷髅幼龙；并不怎么强，但如果它和活着的幼龙有几分相像，这里恐怕不止一只。

entries.source: A skeletal drake, armed with a deadly breath weapon and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一只骷髅飞龙，有着致命的吐息和可怕的利爪。

entries.source: The skeleton of a long-lived wyrm, armed with a deadly breath weapon and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一只活了很久的巨龙的骷髅，有着致命的吐息和可怕的利爪。

entries.source: It is a cross between a human and a bull, but more ... dead.
entries.target: 他像是人类和公牛组合出来的，除了更……死。

entries.source: This big undead minotaur is carrying a nasty looking hammer, imbued with lightning.
entries.target: 这个巨大的亡灵牛头人拿着一把灌注了闪电的可怕巨锤。

entries.source: Vortexes of sickly arcane energies circle this great undead frame.
entries.target: 病态的奥术能量漩涡环绕着这具庞大的亡灵躯体。

entries.source: The air seems to freeze and wither around this terrible undead.
entries.target: 看上去这个可怕的死灵身周的空气都冻结凋零了。
